'''Zinc''' is an uncommon, low-value [[metal]] primarily useful in the creation of [[alloy]]s. It is [[smelter|smelted]] from [[sphalerite]]. Note that, unlike [[sphalerite]] itself, refined zinc is '''not''' [[magma-safe]], or even fire-safe, and will melt in a grass fire.

Zinc may be combined with other metals at a smelter to form the following alloys:
*[[Brass]] = Zinc + [[Copper]]
*[[Nickel silver]] = Zinc + [[Copper]] + 2x [[Nickel]]
